Actual current Claude/Codex hook trust, native task APIs and guarded shell/SDK surfaces require installed-host execution; source matchers alone cannot establish strict-mode enforcement.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: Failed worker-stop notes and starts could be lost or reported only as a short error.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Persist the obligation before delivery; identify its issue/cause; retry through the durable journal/outbox and report the eventual result once.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C10/C22: lose a response, restart the drain and assert one resulting write with retained failed attempt.

evidence_scope.details: Real Git fixtures with GraphQL/provider stand-ins; no live provider observation by this worker.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: An automated pause or later placement could undo the owner decision that work belongs in Backlog.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Preserve explicit human later/hold decisions across pause, finish and background reconciliation until authorized release.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C09/C18: human Backlog/On Hold wins over stale automation and remains attributed.

evidence_scope.details: GraphQL stand-ins; actual human-actor live race remains to be executed.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: The lead, native task tool, connector or worker could claim another person issue.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Enforce principal ownership at every writer and launch boundary; model text and fabricated decision notes do not grant authority.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C21/B08: direct API, task/agent/connector calls and forged session references cannot claim foreign work.

evidence_scope.details: Source tests exercise real hook paths with fake provider facts; second-user live acceptance is blocked by missing credential.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: Fallback configuration discovery read another home or real running profile during an isolated test.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Bind config root explicitly; keep fixture process metadata independent from the machine; unavailable process observation is unknown.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C07/C21/C27: distinct profile roots and inaccessible process metadata never select another session or infer no worker.

evidence_scope.details: Fake process filesystem tests; native macOS/Linux host behavior needs actual execution.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: A test-team issue number could be interpreted using the normal team key or the wrong workflow-state IDs.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Keep immutable team identity with the issue reference; repository TST binding and team-specific state IDs are validated before writes.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C17/C21/C23: normal/test teams share an issue number but never share identity or state IDs; cross-team writes refuse.

evidence_scope.details: Mechanical team fixtures; current primary TST read check is separate from these source tests.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: The lead could take substantive work itself while CLI tasks in progress had no assigned active worker.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: One tracked assignment per worker; lead coordination is separate; every active task has observed ownership and startup evidence.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C06/C36/B01/B09: no untracked worker and no phantom active task; coordinator never invents a task for bookkeeping.

evidence_scope.details: Hook-path mechanical tests; fresh actual host observations remain required.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: Tasks stayed in progress after their worker finished and merged.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Close execution when the assigned worker actually finished and no required own work remains; preserve unknown or unmerged outcomes.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C03/C14/C37: distinguish running, aborted, finished+merged, finished+branch-only and unreadable evidence.

evidence_scope.details: Recorded source examples and mechanical cases; no new end-to-end completion run by this worker.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: Finished no-code/review work was omitted from an enumerated set of closeable delivery statuses.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Execution completion is separate from where an issue waits; derive it from remaining work and evidence, not a duplicated short status list.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C04/C20/B04/B05: a completed reviewable artifact releases execution while the issue awaits human acceptance.

evidence_scope.details: Source mechanical assertions; live review/outcome checks not yet run.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: Pausing a task merely because it awaited a resource made later resumption a forbidden backwards move and concealed unfinished work.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Keep waiting reason, execution state and delivery stage distinct; use explicit approved hold/resume transitions and verified resource eligibility.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C04/C06/C16: resource wait cannot fabricate completion or lose the same task/attempt history.

evidence_scope.details: Mechanical historical cases; approved new hold policy intentionally changes some legacy destinations.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: A detector with incomplete session records could declare no active work and pause a potentially live task.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Unknown visibility does not establish termination; reconcile process identity and retain ownership before recovery or competing admission.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C07/C14: known-dead session can recover; unrecorded live process freezes unsafe repair/admission and surfaces uncertainty.

evidence_scope.details: Real short-lived process plus synthetic native records/provider facts; killed real-host observation was listed NOT_DRIVEN.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: A partial probe/tool commit moved the whole unresolved issue to In Dev and closed its task.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Part-of attribution is not whole-issue delivery; retain acceptance obligations and distinguish support artifacts from completed requested work.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C37/B03: Part-of-only merge records partial evidence without completing the issue; normal completed-issue commit remains deliverable.

evidence_scope.details: Real Git fixtures with fake Linear; source assertions inspected, not rerun.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: One selection mode missed files another mode selected, and carried pass records were treated as fresh execution at a newer commit.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Union applicable selection modes; carry proof only for files actually run at the matched artifact, retaining same-commit carry when valid.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C34/C38: selected-but-unrun files and old-artifact carry cannot satisfy release evidence; current-commit proven carry remains valid.

evidence_scope.details: Production-function unit fixtures and measured incident narrative in source; no fresh case execution here.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: Importing the shared test-record reader eagerly broke minimal materialized rule-tree entry points.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Load optional project-evidence dependencies at the responsible call; a packaged minimal rule/adapter entry point must not require unrelated checkout modules.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C27/C30: isolated installed/minimal packages start without the application checkout; missing required runtime dependency is a clear scoped failure.

evidence_scope.details: Source names the fixture regression and delayed-import fix f535e2574; fresh installed test remains required.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: A background detector found actionable work but it did not reliably reach the active session, or repeated unchanged lines flooded it.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Retain actionable events and dedup by event meaning; distinguish new, previously reported and resolved differences.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: C16/C22/B15: actionable new event is delivered once per authorized session; unchanged repeats are suppressed without dropping new state.

evidence_scope.details: Mechanical log/dedup assertions; receipt by a model is not proved by queued log output.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: An agent asked the owner through Linear and stopped, while the lead did not learn of the ask in time.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Route relevant worker result/ask to its coordinating lead with durable task identity; queued log delivery must not be mistaken for AI acknowledgement or user report.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: Closed-loop acceptance: queue event, deliver to bound lead, record model acknowledgement and user report separately; preserve pending/unacknowledged events on restart.

evidence_scope.details: Real throwaway Git branches plus fake provider mention path; lead-AI acknowledgement is not established by this source.

regression_lessons.prior_failure: A stopped helper left uncommitted remediation work, and later monitoring could overlook the remaining useful changes.
regression_lessons.working_invariant: Recover actual checkpoint/dirty-file ownership and unfinished remediation; user-visible finding resolution requires verified work, not helper exit alone.
regression_lessons.new_regression_oracle: Maintenance regression: reproduce stopped repair, retain owned dirty changes, resume safely, verify regression and track recurrence.

evidence_scope.details: Historical shell regression source; actual bounded repair loop and recurrence tests remain new acceptance work.

closed_loop_lifecycle.stage: User request or newly found work
closed_loop_lifecycle.interpretation: Source requires a Linear issue before native TaskCreate. New Backlog-first admission intentionally tightens legacy placement.
New policy confirms Backlog even where legacy placement chooses Todo for work already in hand.

closed_loop_lifecycle.stage: Create session task and issue linkage
closed_loop_lifecycle.interpretation: Native task name/metadata maps to existing issue; scope cannot be inferred only from free text.
Legacy queue intent/checkpoint rules are inputs; explicit new queue admission is the authority.

closed_loop_lifecycle.stage: Reserve and confirm actual assigned worker
closed_loop_lifecycle.interpretation: Legacy pretool may mark a task in progress before host startup. New core needs startup acknowledgement before granting work lease.
Remote acknowledgement and local execution are distinct; pending/failed synchronization is visible.
Progress differs from heartbeat and native process presence; do not infer success from recent output.

closed_loop_lifecycle.stage: Verify worker result and required merge evidence
closed_loop_lifecycle.interpretation: Inspect actual task, process, own work and Git evidence; unknown or branch-only work remains recoverable.

closed_loop_lifecycle.stage: Settle task execution and synchronize issue facts
closed_loop_lifecycle.interpretation: Close execution and update actual issue delivery/hold/review state separately; retain unresolved writes.
